description: Resolves a finished postal address to coordinates so distance-based rules can run (ADR 068). Distinct from Frappe's own Geolocation Settings, which completes an address as someone types it — different job, different provider account.

fields.description: While off, addresses are stored as usual and simply not geocoded.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: Vendor proxy routes lookups through the hosting provider's endpoint with a site token, so a hosted school needs no Google account of its own. Google talks to the Geocoding API directly with your own key.
fields.label: Provider

fields.description: Google Cloud key with Geocoding API and Places API (New) enabled, or the site token for Vendor proxy. Restrict it by IP address — it is used only server-side and is never sent to a browser, including by the address autocomplete, which is proxied through this server for exactly that reason.
fields.label: API Key

fields.description: Set automatically when you pick a provider. Vendor proxy has no default: it is whatever endpoint your host runs.
fields.label: Base URL

fields.description: A ceiling on lookups per day, counted from the Integration Request log. On Vendor proxy the ceiling is your host's to set and enforce, so it is not editable here. On Google it is your own account being billed. 0 means no ceiling.
fields.label: Daily Lookup Limit

name: Address Geocoding Settings
